question: A customer needs four alarm relays with changeover contacts on the Nokeval 2021. Which alarm cards are needed and in which slots?
expected_answer: Two 2000-REL2 cards (2 changeover relays each): one in slot C and the second in slot B. REL3 has only closing contacts and 2000-I/O is a logic card, so they do not meet the requirement. [All source pages: 8, 9, 17.] [Scoring: Wrong if it proposes REL3 or a single card.]
answer:
To get four alarm relays with changeover contacts on the Nokeval 2021, you need:
*   A Card 2 (2000-REL2) for two relays with changeover contacts [1, p. 9].
*   A second card mounted in slot B [1, p. 9].

The documentation also notes that the second card in slot B can be used if you need four alarms [1, p. 9].
